source_note: 保留既有花园对白及稳定 ID；历史来源为 Garden_Visitors。本次 raw 是社区 Wiki 普通呈现页面对白 DOM 的颜色还原样本，不是服务器原始字节。已有闲聊通过 ref 复用 Hub_General/NPC_Message/Gerald.json，已有实测颜色优先于 Wiki 样本。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: A Carrot King has been scaring off all the good fish, I need to deal with it before I lose more fish.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。Carrot King 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的生物译名胡萝卜王，修正旧译胡萝卜国王。
messages.zh: 一只胡萝卜王把好鱼都吓跑了,我得在失去更多鱼之前解决它。
messages.raw: §fA Carrot King has been scaring off all the good fish, I need to deal with it before I lose more fish.

messages.context: 完成花园访客委托
messages.text: Holy Mackerel! You got me the whole nine yards.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 我的天哪! 你把一整套都给我弄来了。
messages.raw: §fHoly Mackerel! You got me the whole nine yards.

messages.context: 拒绝花园访客委托
messages.text: S'alright, we are all busy some days.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 没事,谁都会有忙不过来的时候。
messages.raw: §fS'alright, we are all busy some days.

messages.context: 渔夫小屋；钓鱼等级低于 V 级时搭话
messages.text: Hmm, you're not quite ready yet.
messages.raw: §fHmm, you're not quite ready yet.
messages.zh: 嗯,你现在还没准备好。

messages.context: 钓鱼等级低于 V 级；指引玩家找钓鱼商人准备装备
messages.text: Go talk to the Fishing Merchant in the Fishing Outpost, get geared up, and get fishin'!
messages.raw: §fGo talk to the §bFishing Merchant §fin the §bFishing Outpost§f, get geared up, and get fishin'!
messages.gloss: Fishing Merchant 沿用钓鱼商人；Fishing Outpost 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的钓鱼前哨。
messages.zh: 先去钓鱼前哨找钓鱼商人,备齐装备,钓起来吧!

segments.text: , get geared up, and get fishin'!

messages.context: 钓鱼等级低于 V 级；说明再次交谈的固定等级门槛
messages.text: Come back once you've reached Fishing Skill V and I'll tell you how you can get to a new island!
messages.raw: §fCome back once you've reached §aFishing Skill V §fand I'll tell you how you can get to a §anew island§f!
messages.gloss: V 是该任务固定门槛，不是动态等级；技能名沿用钓鱼，罗马数字保留。
messages.zh: 等你练到钓鱼技能 V 级再回来,我就告诉你怎么去新的岛屿!

segments.text: and I'll tell you how you can get to a
segments.zh: 再回来,我就告诉你怎么去

messages.context: 达到钓鱼 V 级后首次交谈；提醒玩家安静
messages.text: Keep the noise down, kid!
messages.raw: §fKeep the noise down, kid!
messages.gloss: 保留直率的长辈口吻，不把提醒写成威胁。
messages.zh: 小子,小点声!

messages.context: 达到钓鱼 V 级后首次交谈；介绍妻子 Enid
messages.text: If you want to learn about Fishing, go talk to my wife, Fisherwoman Enid.
messages.raw: §fIf you want to learn about §aFishing§f, go talk to my wife, §9Fisherwoman Enid§f.
messages.gloss: Enid 是 Gerald 的妻子；Fisherwoman Enid 沿用 Fishing/NPC_Message/Captain_Baha.json 的女渔夫 Enid，人名保留。
messages.zh: 想学钓鱼,就去找我太太——女渔夫 Enid。

segments.text: If you want to learn about

messages.context: 达到钓鱼 V 级后首次交谈；指出 Enid 的位置和返回顺序
messages.text: She's fishing a bit upstream. Once she's shown you the ropes, come back and talk to me!
messages.raw: §fShe's fishing a bit §bupstream§f. Once she's shown you the ropes, come back and talk to me!
messages.gloss: shown you the ropes 指带新手入门，不是展示绳索。
messages.zh: 她在上游不远处钓鱼。等她带你入了门,再回来找我!

segments.text: . Once she's shown you the ropes, come back and talk to me!
segments.zh: 不远处钓鱼。等她带你入了门,再回来找我!

messages.context: 与 Enid 交谈后；Gerald 开口请玩家帮忙
messages.text: Hey there buddy, think you can help me out?
messages.raw: §fHey there buddy, think you can help me out?
messages.gloss: buddy 是随和的招呼，不额外建立兄弟等人物关系。
messages.zh: 嘿,能帮我个忙吗?

messages.context: 与 Enid 交谈后；回应 Gerald 的求助，复用已实测且括号细分的选择行
选择 What do you need? 后；介绍与 Baha 一起造船的进度
messages.text: My buddy, Captain Baha, and I are just about done building a ship that can set sail to the Backwater Bayou.
messages.raw: §fMy buddy, §6Captain Baha§f, and I are just about done building a ship that can set sail to the §2Backwater Bayou§f.
messages.gloss: Captain Baha 沿用船长 Baha；Backwater Bayou 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的死水沼泽。
messages.zh: 我和老伙计船长 Baha 造的船就快完工了,能开到死水沼泽去。

segments.text: , and I are just about done building a ship that can set sail to the
segments.zh: 造的船就快完工了,能开到

messages.context: 选择 What do you need? 后；坦白把缺少的引擎掉进池塘
messages.text: All that's left is to add the Rusty Ship Engine, but I tripped and dropped it into the pond here...
messages.raw: §fAll that's left is to add the §cRusty Ship Engine§f, but I tripped and dropped it into the §bpond §fhere...
messages.gloss: 所需物品 Rusty Ship Engine 沿用本地整名译文：Fishing/GUI_Item/Ship_And_Guides_September.json#ship_rusty_ship_engine → 生锈的船舶引擎。
messages.zh: 就差装上生锈的船舶引擎了,可我绊了一跤,它就掉进了这儿的池塘里...

segments.text: All that's left is to add the
, but I tripped and dropped it into the
segments.zh: 了,可我绊了一跤,它就掉进了这儿的

messages.context: 选择 What do you need? 后；请求玩家钓回掉落的引擎
messages.text: Do you think you could fish it out for me?
messages.raw: §fDo you think you could fish it out for me?
messages.gloss: it 指前句的引擎，不添加额外物品要求。
messages.zh: 能帮我把它钓上来吗?

messages.context: 选择 What do you need? 后；说明钓回引擎后应交给谁
messages.text: If you find it, bring it to Captain Baha so you can set sail!
messages.raw: §fIf you find it, bring it to §6Captain Baha §fso you can set sail!
messages.gloss: Captain Baha 沿用船长 Baha；保留找到引擎后交给 Baha 的任务顺序。
messages.zh: 找到了就把它交给船长 Baha,这样你就能起航了!

segments.text: If you find it, bring it to

messages.context: 尚未钓起引擎；重复提醒玩家所需物品
messages.text: Can you fish up the Rusty Ship Engine for me?
messages.raw: §fCan you fish up the §cRusty Ship Engine §ffor me?
messages.gloss: 所需物品 Rusty Ship Engine 沿用本地整名译文：Fishing/GUI_Item/Ship_And_Guides_September.json#ship_rusty_ship_engine → 生锈的船舶引擎。
messages.zh: 能帮我把生锈的船舶引擎钓上来吗?

messages.context: 尚未钓起引擎；提醒搜索地点
messages.text: It's somewhere in this pond here.
messages.raw: §fIt's somewhere in this §bpond §fhere.
messages.zh: 它就在这池塘里的某个地方。

messages.context: 尚未钓起引擎；说明找回引擎后可出海
messages.text: Once you fish it out, you can set sail to the Backwater Bayou!
messages.raw: §fOnce you fish it out, you can set sail to the §2Backwater Bayou§f!
messages.gloss: Backwater Bayou 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的死水沼泽；不补写 Wiki 该句未提到的菜单步骤。
messages.zh: 把它钓上来,你就能起航前往死水沼泽了!

segments.text: Once you fish it out, you can set sail to the
segments.zh: 把它钓上来,你就能起航前往

messages.context: 已经钓起引擎；Gerald 高兴地认出引擎
messages.text: Ah! The Rusty Ship Engine! Perfect!
messages.raw: §fAh! The §cRusty Ship Engine§f! Perfect!
messages.gloss: 所需物品 Rusty Ship Engine 沿用本地整名译文：Fishing/GUI_Item/Ship_And_Guides_September.json#ship_rusty_ship_engine → 生锈的船舶引擎。
messages.zh: 啊! 生锈的船舶引擎! 太好了!

messages.context: 已经钓起引擎；再次提醒带给 Baha
messages.text: Bring that to Captain Baha and he'll be able to help you set sail!
messages.raw: §fBring that to §6Captain Baha §fand he'll be able to help you set sail!
messages.gloss: Captain Baha 沿用船长 Baha。
messages.zh: 把它带给船长 Baha,他就能帮你起航了!

segments.text: and he'll be able to help you set sail!

messages.context: 已经钓起引擎；指引 Baha 所在位置
messages.text: He's behind the Fisherman's Hut, waiting by the Ship.
messages.raw: §fHe's behind the §bFisherman's Hut§f, waiting by the §6Ship§f.
messages.gloss: Fisherman's Hut 沿用 _shared/Terms.json 的渔夫小屋；Ship 是小屋后方的船。
messages.zh: 他在渔夫小屋后面,就在船旁边等着。

messages.context: 已经钓起引擎；不好意思地请玩家略去自己失手的事
messages.text: Just leave out the part about me dropping it, would ya?
messages.raw: §fJust leave out the part about me dropping it, would ya?
messages.gloss: 延续失手掉落引擎的轻松笑点，不增加欺骗任务或奖励条件。
messages.zh: 不过,可别提是我把它弄掉的,行不?

messages.context: 将引擎交给 Baha 后；点名感谢玩家
messages.text: Thanks for helping me find the Rusty Ship Engine, %s!
messages.raw: §fThanks for helping me find the §cRusty Ship Engine§f, §8%s§f!

placeholders.desc: 完成找回引擎任务的玩家名，保持原文

messages.gloss: Wiki 的 <username> 转为有类型的动态占位符，保留灰色玩家名；Rusty Ship Engine 沿用 Fishing/GUI_Item/Ship_And_Guides_September.json#ship_rusty_ship_engine → 生锈的船舶引擎。
messages.zh: %s,多谢你帮我找回生锈的船舶引擎!

segments.text: Thanks for helping me find the

messages.context: 将引擎交给 Baha 后；介绍航行入口
messages.text: You can use the Ship Navigator to set sail to the Backwater Bayou!
messages.raw: §fYou can use the §6Ship Navigator §fto set sail to the §2Backwater Bayou§f!
messages.gloss: Ship Navigator 沿用 Fishing/NPC_Message/Captain_Baha.json 的船舶导航器；Backwater Bayou 沿用死水沼泽。
messages.zh: 现在你可以用船舶导航器起航,前往死水沼泽了!

messages.context: 将引擎交给 Baha 后；祝玩家旅途平安
messages.text: Safe travels!
messages.raw: §fSafe travels!
messages.zh: 一路平安!

note:
身份: 渔夫小屋的渔夫，Enid 的丈夫，两个孩子的父亲，与船长 Baha 一起造船。
关系: 起初提醒新手安静，随后请玩家帮忙找回掉进池塘的引擎，也会到访花园。
说话方式: 朴素口语，略有长辈式的直率，熟络后亲切健谈。
性格与词汇: 喜爱清静的水钓，重视家人和救过自己的老伙计；钓上来、起航、老本行。
禁用风格: 不写官腔、伪文言或硬塞网络梗，不补造任务机制，不改变人物关系。
